liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Crazy Fingers** (3 reviews): Stumbly playing, with a funny exit from the jam into the 'Life may be sweeter' line; Contains major Garcia breakdowns that may bother some listeners [15][21][23]
- **Close Encounter's Space** (3 reviews): The Close Encounters space is excellent; The Close Encounters theme appears in space, starting around the 8:00 mark on this recording [21][22][25]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 other source): Crackle in the first half sounds like a blowing speaker, and also appears on the soundboard [8]
- **Candyman** (1 review): A man walked around throwing Hershey Kisses at people during this song [19]
- **Queen Jane, Approximately** (1 review): Bobby's delivery of the bandanas line made the reviewer's whole section scream [17]
- **China Doll** (1 review): Playing is erratic and all over the place [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-07-15.aud.cousinit.97691.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 173 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1989-07-15.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.125722.Flac1644**: audience recording; 23 songs; 175 min [2]. Said about its sound: A couple of songs have minimal music loss from recorder problems [2]
- **gd1989-07-15.sbd.miller.97307.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 177 min; rated 2/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Tape flips occur during drums and at the end of Stella Blue; set 2 disc change is seamless [5]
- **gd1989-07-15.nak300.wahba-volkerding.96609.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 182 min [8]. Said about its sound: Tape flips occur in the jam before drums and right before Stella Blue [8]
- **gd89-07-15.sbd.11266.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 4.26/5 by 19 [10]. Said about its sound: Soundboard quality is only so-so but improves after space; Soundboard is not the best but well above average; Sound quality is not great, about a 4-minus [16][18][23]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this show began a run of dates that ended at Alpine Valley [15]
- Reviewer heard Crazy Fingers from the hill while watching fireworks in the distance [18]
- On the lawn, the field speakers lagged noticeably behind the stage speakers for the first three songs [25]
- For most fans not living locally, this was their first look at Deer Creek [26]
- After stadiums like RFK and Giants Stadium, the band seemed to enjoy this smaller venue [19]
- Reviewer finds set 1 stronger than set 2, and says Alpine Valley was far better [23]
- Deer Creek followed by Alpine Valley was one of the best back-to-back venue runs of the period [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-07-15.aud.cousinit.97691.flac16**: taped by cousinit; transferred by cousinit; source: NAK550>2 CM300\'s w/CP4 Shotguns, 1 CM300 (Center Mic) [1]
- **gd1989-07-15.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.125722.Flac1644**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony D6, Tapes: Maxell XLII-S 90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg… [2]
- **gd1989-07-15.sbd.miller.97307.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1 Encore: SBD -> Master Cassette -> CD; Set 2: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [5]. Also: Soundboard transfer was pitch corrected with help from Joe B. Jones [5]
- **gd1989-07-15.nak300.wahba-volkerding.96609.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Eddie Wahba and Pat Volkerding; source: Nak300 (4 mic mix; 2 shotgun, 2 cardioid) > Tandy 4 channel mixer > Sony TC-D5M (pass thru) > Yamaha MT1X (dbx type II encode, Maxell XL-IIS) [8]
- **gd89-07-15.sbd.11266.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MR > DAT > C > DAT > CDR [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Set List Tees: [1989 - 07/15 - Grateful Dead at Deer Creek Music Center, Unisex Set Li](https://setlisttees.com/products/1989-07-15-grateful-dead-at-deer-creek-music-center-unisex-set-list-t-shirt) [28]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead CD DEER CREEK, IN 7/15/1989 from ENJOYING THE RIDE Box Set NEW | #4884158973](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-cd-deer-creek-15-1989-4884158973) [29]
- Fan art by OnlineRadioBox.com: [Grateful Dead - The Music Never Stopped (Live) (2025)](https://onlineradiobox.com/album/1800174731-the-music-never-stop) [30]
- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead ticket - 7/15/89 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, Indiana (borrowed from www.psilo.com)](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3349035627/) [31]

Soundboard transfer was pitch corrected with help from Joe B. Jones
Tape flips occur during drums and at the end of Stella Blue; set 2 disc change is seamless
Tape flips occur in the jam before drums and right before Stella Blue
Crackle in the first half sounds like a blowing speaker, and also appears on the soundboard
Chain: soundboard to MR to DAT to C to DAT to CDR
